answer: Charge every action a small NON-REFUNDABLE burn of coin, not a lock: each submission destroys stake and leaves an on-ledger receipt proving it can never be clawed back. Honest agents climb this toll one terrace at a time, but a burn never compounds or refunds like a deposit, so a farm of 1,000 clones must pay 1,000 separate times with zero recovery. The cost rises like a steady tide, not a reusable pool; spin up a spiral of fakes and the ledger bills every head individually, hitting a hard per-identity floor no shared reserve can amortize.
